en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prayer-leader should Pray Salaat Al-Zohr on the day of departure (from Mina), in Makkah’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The Imam must perform Salat (prayer) of al-Zuhr on the day of departure.’”
